name: Vossa Yuzu-Sorrel Fizz
manufacturer: Vossa Refresh (subsidiary of Helion Consumer Group)
description: A mid-range sparkling soda combining synth-yuzu brightness with sorrel's cranberry-adjacent depth, lightly sweetened with agave-derived syrup. Marketed as a 'daily ritual' drink for Tier 2-3 commuters.
flavor_profile: Crisp yuzu zest opens, transitions into tart sorrel warmth with a hint of clove. Light-medium carbonation, clean finish.
cultural_context: Vossa is sold in transit vending units throughout Meridian 88's mag-rail network. It's become associated with the morning commute and is often called 'rail juice' colloquially. Helion Consumer Group acquired the independent Vossa brand in 2187 and most longtime fans claim it hasn't been the same since.
story_hooks: A Vossa distribution machine on a Tier 2 mag-rail platform has been dispensing an unauthorized formula — richer, more complex — for three weeks. No one at Helion can explain it.
The original Vossa founder, bought out in 2187, has quietly been developing a competing formula and is looking for underground distribution partners.
A BCI-linked ad campaign for Vossa is being used to deliver subliminal brand-loyalty signals — a whistleblower needs someone to help them expose it.
